text: SEMKIT-033 docstrings, rules changed by SEMKIT-032: (1) match_type: a phrase with quotes/brackets is not wrapped again; operator goes inside the existing quote/bracket pair; brackets/quotes/quoted_* replace the old wrap; antisemantic drops the old wrap. (2) translit to='ru': a word in capitals reads by small-letter groups and stays in capitals (ZHUK→ЖУК); new groups shch, ts, yy; 'y' after a/u before no vowel is й; ь and ъ (and е/ё) cannot reverse. (3) change_case toponyms: punctuation at word edges is ignored and kept; a hyphen splits a word so «ростов-на-дону»→«Ростов-на-Дону». (4) phonetic: whole-word table has 'ikea'→'икеа'. (5) replace_words: punctuation at the edges of the found words is kept around the replacement; an empty replacement removes the words with that punctuation. (6) extract_utm: only the part before '#' is searched. (7) split_digits: a size NxM (x latin/cyrillic, any case) stays whole. (8) switch_layout: signs of the Russian layout map to English keys and back: . = /, ',' = ?, : = ^, ; = $, ? = &, " = @, № = #, / = |.
note: Goes into SEMKIT-033's body (the docstring rules changed by 032) before 033 starts.
